description_html: Greg responds to the challenge that it’s arbitrary for God to limit our opportunity to repent and believe to this lifetime, then he talks to callers about a contradiction in Genesis, the lack of spiritual growth in babies who are never born, and whether God or parents create souls.

title: Why Does God Limit Our Opportunity to Repent and Believe to This Lifetime?
